Man Rescued After Being Trapped Inside Garbage Truck

A man was rescued after becoming trapped inside a garbage truck in downtown Toronto. Passers-by heard screams coming from inside the truck and alerted authorities. Emergency services responded and successfully extracted the man. He sustained injuries described as 'life-altering' and was transported to a hospital. The man is reportedly from the United States.
